title: Compact-region nonhyperbolic deformations of Hn/Z^(n-2) preserving the hyperbolic scalar-curvature lower bound in every dimension n>=3
author: Tianze Hao; Yuhao Hu; Peng Liu; Yuguang Shi
source_title: Rigidity and Non-Rigidity of H^n/Z^(n-2) with Scalar Curvature Bounded from Below
difficulty_reason: The construction matches two distinct warped-product boundary geometries while making the replacement scalar curvature and mean curvature sufficiently large. It modifies the hyperbolic collar by a flat-ended radial factor whose derivative supplies a strict scalar-curvature margin. That margin absorbs the smoothing loss in the gluing theorem, producing a complete nonhyperbolic metric with an exactly unchanged exterior and the sharp lower bound.
source_version: Official SIGMA 19 (2023) article 083, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2023.083; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Full Theorem1.2 and Section2.1–2.3 author construction are supplied, including all new coordinate/mean-curvature estimates, the replacement metric and the collar scalar-curvature margin. n>=3, the initial quotient is the standard parabolic lattice translation quotient, and the conclusion is existence of a complete non-globally-hyperbolic Riemannian manifold isometric to that quotient outside compact subsets with R>=-n(n-1). The statement does not assert a fixed topology or a global metric perturbation on the same manifold; those later refinements are not counted. The published corner-smoothing theorem [8,Theorem5] and standard warped scalar-curvature formula are background, while their applicability and absorption of the epsilon loss are explicitly proved. Lemma2.1 coordinate derivatives are author-marked routine computations, not a missing new core.
